SELECT
    d."XCL_038" AS forename,
    d."XCL_039" AS surname,
    d."XCL_041" AS nationality,
    d."XCL_042" AS wikipedia_url,
    d."XCL_040" AS date_of_birth,
    r."XCL_069" AS race_name,
    r."XCL_066" AS race_year
FROM lapTimes AS lt
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt."XCL_043" = r."XCL_065"
WHERE lt."XCL_048" = (
    SELECT MIN(lt2."XCL_048")
    FROM lapTimes AS lt2
    WHERE lt2."XCL_048" IS NOT NULL
)
AND d."XCL_040" > '1980-12-31'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM qualifying AS q
    WHERE q."XCL_058" = d."XCL_034"
      AND q."XCL_063" IS NOT NULL
      AND q."XCL_063" <> ''
)
LIMIT 1
